title: QA Engineer ( Manual + Automation )
description:
We are looking for a QA Engineer with **1–2 years of experience** in both Manual and Automation Testing.

The candidate should be able to understand requirements, prepare test scenarios, identify bugs effectively, and contribute towards automation testing for web and mobile applications.

The ideal candidate should have good analytical skills, attention to detail, and understanding of software testing processes.

Responsibilities

Understand project requirements and functional specifications

Prepare and execute test cases, test scenarios, and test reports

Perform Manual Testing for web and mobile applications

Identify, report, track, and verify bugs/issues

Perform Regression, Smoke, Functional, and UI Testing

Collaborate with developers, project managers, and business teams

Create and maintain automation test scripts

Participate in sprint planning and QA discussions

Ensure product quality before production releases

Validate APIs and backend responses where required

Required Skills

Manual Testing

Good understanding of SDLC and STLC

Experience in:

Functional Testing

Regression Testing

Smoke Testing

UI/UX Validation

Cross\-browser / Cross\-device Testing

Strong bug reporting and debugging skills

Experience using tools like:

Jira

ClickUp

Trello

TestRail (optional)

Automation Testing

Basic to intermediate knowledge of automation frameworks

Experience with any one or more:

Selenium

Cypress

Playwright

Appium

Knowledge of writing and executing automation test cases

Understanding of CI/CD testing flow is a plus

Additional Skills

Basic API testing knowledge using:

Postman

Swagger

Basic SQL/database understanding

Good communication and documentation skills

Ability to independently test modules/features

Good to Have

Experience with performance or security testing

Familiarity with Git/GitHub

Knowledge of Firebase, logs, or analytics debugging

Basic scripting knowledge in JavaScript, Java, or Python

Interview Evaluation Areas

Ability to find practical bugs

Test case writing quality

Real\-world testing approach

Basic automation scripting knowledge

Communication and reporting skills

Analytical thinking

title: Senior Data Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Position Overview The Senior Data Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data assets, reporting solutions, and data integration processes.

This role serves as the primary quality assurance resource for Power BI reporting, SQL\-based data warehouses, ETL processes, and data integrations from internal and third\-party systems.

The Senior Data QA Specialist will perform comprehensive validation of data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and database objects while proactively identifying and resolving data discrepancies across multiple systems.

The position works closely with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity throughout the data lifecycle.

Additionally, this role supports production operations through troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect management, and resolution of data\-related issues impacting business reporting and analytics.

This position will report to the Director — Enterprise Data and BI.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹15,000,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: QA Engineer - CRM
description:
We are looking for a **QA Engineer** with strong experience in **CRM application testing, CRM workflows/blueprints, and load/performance testing**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Test CRM applications and end\-to\-end business processes.
* Understand and test **CRM Blueprints, Workflows, Automations, Business Rules, and Approvals**.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Perform **load, stress, performance, and scalability testing**.
* Strong experience testing **high concurrent users, API load, response time, and system performance**.
* Experience with **load balancing, distributed environments, and performance bottleneck identification**.
* Perform **API testing** using Postman or similar tools.
* Perform **SQL/database validation and data reconciliation**.
* Test CRM integrations with third\-party applications and APIs.
* Create test cases, test scenarios, and defect reports.
* Work closely with developers, business analysts, product teams, and clients.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum activities.

**Mandatory Skills**

* **3\+ years QA experience**
* Strong **CRM testing experience**
* Good understanding of **CRM Blueprints \& Workflows**
* Strong **Load \& Performance Testing** experience
* Good understanding of **Load Balancing \& Scalability**
* API Testing
* SQL/Database Testing
* Functional, Regression \& Integration Testing
* Jira or similar defect management tools
* Strong analytical and **communication skills**

**Preferred**

* Experience with **Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot**, or similar CRM platforms.
* Experience with **JMeter, LoadRunner, k6, Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress**.
* Experience with cloud\-based CRM applications and integrations.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience in QA Engineer?
* How many years of experience in CRM testing?
* How many years of experience in CRM Blueprints \& Workflows?
* How many years of experience in Load \& Performance Testing?
* Your Current Salary?
* Expected Salary?
* How soon you can join?

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**IMPORTANT: Applications are accepted ONLY via our official website**

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with good communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills who wants to grow into project management within an IT services environment.

* Coordinate with **Developers, QA, Business Analysts, Designers, and other project team members** to track dependencies, pending discussions, and project progress.
* Ability to understand basic client/business requirements and help maintain proper **project documentation, task updates, meeting notes, and follow\-up records**.
* Familiarity with project management and communication tools such as **Jira, Trello, Slack, or similar platforms** is an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of technology stacks such as **Laravel, Node.js, React.js, mobile technologies, or other software development technologies** will be preferred.
* Good **English communication and presentation skills**, attention to detail, strong follow\-up ability, and willingness to learn client communication and project management under guidance.
